name: tiny-engineer
description: Claude Code plugins for the Tiny Engineer desk robot

plugins.name: tiny-engineer
plugins.description: Tiny Engineer desk robot for Claude Code: poses on every agent event (hooks) and speech through its speaker (tiny-engineer-play skill)

hooks.command: grep -qs "hook claude-code" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/settings.json" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/settings.local.json" && exit 0; command -v tiny-engineer >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; tiny-engineer hook claude-code
